podcast.title: Fyre Festival Aftermath and Conviction
podcast.body: Following the catastrophic failure of the Fyre Festival, Billy McFarland faced swift media condemnation, numerous lawsuits, and investigations. He was subsequently arrested, convicted of wire fraud, and sentenced to six years in jail for his role in the deceptive marketing and execution of the event. "And McFarland was arrested, convicted of wire fraud, and sentenced to six years in jail."

podcast.title: Fyre Festival Co-Founder and Promoter
podcast.body: Billy McFarland positioned himself as an entrepreneurial concert promoter and, with rapper Ja Rule, conceived the Fyre Festival. The event promised an ultra-exclusive multi-day concert on a private Bahamian island with VIP packages up to $250,000, but failed to deliver on luxury, food, or performances. "Billy McFarland, fancied himself to be an entrepreneurial concert promoter. Together with rapper Ja Rule, he conceived the idea of an ultra-exclusive multi-day concert event on a private island in the Bahamas."
